desired_result: Choose the first slice of arcadia bug: dedupe-only intake (A), intake plus automatic promotion of recurring arcadia learn lessons (B), or nothing now (C).
rationale: Issue #2379 lists A and B as the operator's choice. A reasonable person could pick B to close the gap that made the record run's lessons depend on memory. Recommendation A: promotion is an unattended writer over noisy input and should wait until the matcher is calibrated on real traffic; B's two Actions are drafted and reuse A's key and matcher unchanged. Revival trigger for B under A: after one weekly triage cycle with arcadia bug live, at least 3 recurring lessons without an Issue and no more than 1 false merge in A's receipts. Companion plan Ask: plan-arcadia-bug-intake-slice-a-20261109. Memo: docs/reports/arcadia-bug-intake-plan-20261109/memo.md

options.label: A. Dedupe-only intake first (6 Actions, zero model calls)
options.consequence: Agents stop hand-searching Issues once the guidance Action merges; about 1.5 to 2 sessions of build. A recurring lesson still becomes an Issue only when an agent files it. B revives on its named trigger and reuses A unchanged.

options.label: B. A plus automatic promotion of recurring lessons (8 Actions)
options.consequence: Recurring lessons become Issues without anyone remembering to file them, for roughly a third more build. Adds a writer with no caller in the loop over inferences and low-confidence observations before the matcher is calibrated; a false merge or Issue flood lands on a 357-Issue backlog that triage is still shrinking.

options.label: C. Do nothing now
options.consequence: No build cost. Hand searching and duplicates continue at about 30 bug-shaped Issues a week; Decision 0121's utility stays unbuilt and the operator's 2026-11-09 request stays open.
